agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: A cold, bureaucratic aesthetic defined by brutalist silhouettes, clinical materials, and high-contrast signal red accents. Attire reflects a hierarchy of actuarial precision and economic leverage within a basalt and glass environment.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Dominant black with sharp white trim and mandatory red armband.
Heavy use of silver and mint highlights over dark base.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Sharp angles, high collars, tech-integrated chest pieces.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Darkest blacks with high-contrast red and silver accents.
Mixed greys and blacks with subtle mint fluorescence.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Slightly bulkier due to hidden pockets and tools.

visual_consistency_rules: 1px selective black outlines for all characters.
High-contrast signal red used only for status or danger elements.
Shadows must be harsh, vertical, and match the mint-tinted lighting.

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art, brutalist museum interior, black basalt, frosted glass, clinical mint lighting, signal red accents, 16-bit aesthetic
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art character, clinical actuary attire, white ceramic accessories, sharp shadows, 32x32 grid
